name: resume_expired_seq_reset
comment: resume from an expired seq (typed reset): a reader is at seq=0 (caught up right after the initial snapshot -- PH0-D20 -- before consuming the pushed delta), which is below a NEW snapshot that later re-bases the store at seq=1 (the delta folded in, retiring the old delta window); its next read cannot be served from retained deltas -> state=reset, reset_reason=retention_exceeded, with a fresh snapshot+tail attached so the reader recovers in-band (roadmap Sec 3.2)
